findings.message: The dialog has role="dialog" but no aria-labelledby; its visible heading is not connected to it.
findings.evidence: role=dialog without aria-labelledby; <h2> found at line 16 with no id.
findings.fix: Give the <h2> an id and set aria-labelledby on the dialog, or use the native <dialog> with the Title part.

findings.message: outline: none on :focus removes keyboard focus on the Cancel button and nothing replaces it.
findings.evidence: outline removed; no :focus-visible rule for the same element.
findings.fix: Replace with a :focus-visible rule: outline: var(--lq-focus-ring-width) solid var(--lq-color-border-focus); outline-offset: var(--lq-focus-ring-offset).

findings.message: Two of three buttons define no hover or active treatment.
findings.evidence: No :hover or :active rule for the buttons at lines 31 and 33; line 35 (primary) is complete.
findings.fix: Add :hover (background-color: var(--lq-color-bg-secondary-hover)) and :active (translate: 0 1px), or use the catalog button.

findings.message: The Rename button swaps its label for a spinner while saving, so it changes width and loses its name.
findings.evidence: The label is gone from the DOM while saving; no aria-busy.
findings.fix: Keep the label, render the spinner in the leading-icon slot, set aria-busy and ignore presses while saving.

findings.message: The dialog surface uses literal values (background: #fff, border-radius: 16px, a hard-coded shadow) that ignore the consumer's theme and dark mode.
findings.evidence: #fff, 16px and the shadow literal do not resolve to any role in the html binding.
findings.fix: Use var(--lq-color-bg-surface), var(--lq-radius-surface) and var(--lq-shadow-lg) (color.bg.surface, radius.surface, shadow.lg).

findings.message: Initial focus lands on the text input, which is fine here — but Escape and scrim-click both close the dialog while the field is dirty, discarding the edit without asking.
findings.evidence: The close handler is wired to both; no dirty check.
findings.fix: Guard dismissal when the field is dirty, or keep the draft on reopen.

findings.message: "OK" does not say what happens; the action renames a project.

summary: Capped at C: the dialog has no accessible name and one button removes keyboard focus. States are the weakest dimension — two buttons have no hover/active treatment and the submit reflows while saving. Content is nearly clean apart from an "OK" label.
